verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We will walk
Through the battlefield
Though the arrows fly by day

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We will stand
In the midst of it
And still we will be safe

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
For You promised
You'll deliver us
From the hands of the unjust

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
So we sing
To You, our refuge
You're our God in Whom we trust

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
We won't fear
The terror of the night
Under your wings we hide

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Thousands fall
But Your faithfulness
Keep us safe with You by our side

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
For You promised
You'll deliver us
From the hands of the unjust

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
So we sing
To You, our refuge
You're our God in Whom we trust

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
God is with us
God is with us
God is with us
God is with us

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
God is with us (in the darkest night)
God is with us (in the raging storm)
God is with us (on the battlefield)
God is with us (we will overcome)
